sloka: गिरैर्वज्राभिमृष्टस्य दीर्यतः सदृशस्वनम् ।विस्फारयन् वै वेगेन बालचन्द्रनतं धनुः ।। ६.१०८.७ ।।
transliteration: girairvajrābhimṛṣṭasya dīryataḥ sadṛśasvanam ।visphārayan vai vegena bālacandranataṁ dhanuḥ ।। 6.108.7 ।।

translations.english: The chariot bells fixed to the huge flag post were making sounds, yoked to dark horses, and was shining with splendor with rage. It was glowing like a bright sun in the sky displaying its splendor, like the aerial chariot. It looked like a cloud holding water, releasing water of arrows from Rakshasa king's bow. The king of humans saw this chariot.
translations.hindi: उन चमचमाते चक्रां से सारा आकाश बेसे ही प्रकाशित हो गया ; जैसे गिरते हुए सूय चन्द्रादि ग्रहों से समस्त दिशाएँ प्रकाशित हो जाती हैं \८॥ तानि चिच्छेर बाणोधेश्वक्राणि स त राघव! । आयुधानि च चित्राणि रावणस्य चमूमुखे
